description: Surfaced by fz-lfp classification. Golden expects {5,80,9,288,...}/368; run+build produce {5,80,14,448,...}/528; interp produces {5,80,10,320,...}/400. comments.text: ROOT-CAUSED (2026-07-15, report-only -- correct per no-masked-fix): all drift localized to Enum.reduce (count/member? byte-identical to golden at HEAD).
